content: What is the state of efforts to implement generalised rewriting in Lean, in particular Mathlib's grewrite? I'm seeking to implement a generalised rewriting package inspired by what exists in Rocq and wanted to know if there is any currently active work in this area and if there are any particular improvements people would find useful.

I added the generalized rewriting tactic grw to mathlib about a year ago, and have continued to work on it since. It should now support the features that Rocq's generalized rewriting has. It also supports a new feature, strict rewriting, that lets you rewrite with strict inequalities (a < b) in a useful way.

See also the announcement thread for this tactic: #mathlib4 > Announcement: New `grw` tactic
